support_text: Astragaloside IV and cycloastragenol reduced ROS production in endothelial cells. Cells were pretreated with astragaloside IV (AIV, 10 µM), cycloastragenol (CA, 10 µM), AICAR (500 µM) or Mito Q (0.1 µM) in the presence or absence of compound C (25 µM) and then incubated with PA (100 µM) for 24 h. Data were expressed as the mean ± SD from three independent experiments.
